messages:
Maya: Heads-up — found a shortlink rot on the runtime guide that breaks the VPC section. link-scan flagged it: https://redwood.docs/runtime/vpc#networking -> 404 redirect to /old
Alex: link? I can take a look
Maya: https://redwood.docs/runtime/vpc (click the 'networking' anchor). The shortlink is /r/vpc-networking; scan logs:
```
link-scan: 2024-07-10 09:12:04 - 301 -> /old
```
Maya: quick fix is to replace /r/vpc-networking with /runtime/vpc#networking and re-run snapshot
link-scan-bot: ⚠️ Found redirect chain on /r/vpc-networking -> /old -> /runtime/vpc
Chris: I can open a tiny PR, pinging @alex for owner review
Alex: @Chris thanks — can you add a changelog entry + include sed one-liner?
Chris: will do. sed: `git grep -l '/r/vpc-networking' | xargs sed -i 's#/r/vpc-networking#/runtime/vpc#'`
Jordan: small note — JA localization uses shortlinks; we should copy the change to ja/ as well
Maya: good catch, @Jordan — can you check if ja/ has it? If not, add to PR
Alex: If PR lands today I'll merge and run the doc-snapshot job. :+1:
Chris: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/4821 — added sed and intl tweak
Maya: Thanks team, I'll follow the snapshot results and flag any remaining broken anchors
Alex: nice, close the loop with the link-scan fix ticket
Maya: filed ticket INC-1245 for followup
link-scan-bot: ✅ Re-scan queued after PR merge
